name: A Wildcard Hero trains the ranks of what it knows at any class trainer and Book of Ascension
contract: A Wildcard Hero rolls its abilities at rank 1 and has no trainer of its own. Any class trainer, of whatever class, and any Book of Ascension teach it the higher ranks of the spells it knows, along the client's own rank ladders (SpellRank.dbc), one rank at a time: Arcane Shot rank 2 (14281, level 12) at a rogue trainer, and at a Book of Ascension Arcane Missiles rank 2 (5146, level 8), a rank Ascension added that the stock chain lacks, before rank 3 (5144, level 16). A rank that is not the next one, or not of an ability it rolled, is refused, and unlearning the ability takes the trained ranks with it. The Wildcard Auto shot entry's passive (965202) brings Auto Shot (75) with it and takes it away again.

steps.label: Let login hooks settle
A rolled Arcane Shot at rank 1
Talk to the rogue trainer
The training option is shown to the Hero
Ask for training
The option opens the trainer window
Arcane Shot rank 2 is in it, available
A rogue rank the Hero has no lower rank of is not
Buy Arcane Shot rank 2 from a rogue trainer
The rogue trainer taught the hunter rank
Ask the rogue trainer for Sinister Strike rank 2
A rank without its lower rank is refused
A rolled Arcane Missiles at rank 1
Ask the book for Arcane Missiles rank 3 first
Rank 3 is not the next rank
Buy Arcane Missiles rank 2 from a Book of Ascension
The book taught Ascension's rank 2
Ask for rank 3 below its level
Below level 16 rank 3 is refused
Buy Arcane Missiles rank 3
The book taught rank 3
Unlearn the rolled Arcane Missiles
Its rank 2 goes with it
and its rank 3
The Auto shot entry's passive
Auto Shot comes with it
Unlearn the Auto shot entry
Auto Shot goes with it
